parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the cluster ID.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the page to return.

Page number starts from page 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.\
Valid values: 1 to 50.\
Default value: 10.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc list-commands --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --command-id c-hz01v8vudql0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
